description: Use this when the user wants to find out whether their own startup, app or business idea is worth building: whether there is a market, who has the problem and would pay for it, whether to quit a job or spend months on it, or to rehearse the questions an accelerator or investor will ask about the idea. Opens a live voice interview with Alex, GoNoGo's AI startup mentor (a talking video avatar): he asks who has the problem, what they do about it today, who pays and why now, and records the answers; GoNoGo then researches the market and competitors behind the answers and gives a GO / NO-GO verdict with reasons. One interview per idea: to compare several ideas, run one for each. Creates a project on the user's GoNoGo account. Do not use for running an existing business, writing a business plan document, naming or branding, coding help, or legal, tax or investment advice. The user taps Start and talks; stay silent while the interview runs.

idea.description: The idea in the user's words, if they already said it

language.description: Interview language as an ISO 639-1 code (the language of the chat), default en

name: interview_with_alex
title: Pressure-test a startup idea with Alex
